[LNUL.5.5] **The fallible cast `::T?` is a `T?` producer.** A fallible conversion
`<expr>::T?` ([LCST.4.2.2]) yields a `T?` and feeds the consumers
above — `??` ([LNUL.5.3]), Kleene logic ([LNUL.4.2]), and narrowing ([LNUL.5.4]) —
with no new machinery. Runtime null-propagation: when the source is nullable and
evaluates to `null`, `null::T?` yields `null`; a bare `null::T` (a total target on
a nullable source) is a compile error ([LCST.4.2.3]), not a runtime propagation —
so `null` reaches a cast result only through a `?` target.
